decisions.title: Candidate distribution channel
decisions.selected: Private Git distribution is the candidate direction; no package publication or installer activation is approved by this planning task.
alternatives: pipx from a private package index
decisions.consequence: Before implementation, a human must approve an immutable commit or signed release identity, digest/provenance, supported runtimes, private-Git authentication, and credential-redaction policy.

decisions.title: Target collision default
decisions.selected: Fail before mutation and report every conflict.
decisions.consequence: The future installer must not overwrite or merge unresolved target-owned files; Git-root validation, untrusted-state handling, locking, rollback, and symlink protection remain implementation gates.

human_approval_gates: Approve the immutable distribution identity and provenance contract.
Approve target-repository ownership, Git-root, locking, rollback, and symlink/reparse-point behavior.
Approve activation of the first executable task after this planning bundle is reviewed.
